tagline: Images ko 100% browser me compress karo
heroSub: Aapki photos is device se bahar kabhi nahi jati. No backend, no account, no tracking — sirf fast aur private compression.
dropSub: ya click karke chuno — JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC
failed: Fail ho gaya — dusra format try karo
noImages: Abhi koi image nahi hai. Upar photo drop karke shuru karo.
supportedNote: Sirf wahi formats dikhaye jate hain jo aapka browser asli me encode kar sakta hai.
footer: Vite + React se client-side banaya gaya hai. Static site par host hota hai — aapki images lene ke liye koi server hi nahi hai.
aboutP1: ImgCompressor ek privacy-first image tool hai. Ye poori tarah aapke browser me chalta hai — aapki photos lene, store karne ya analyse karne ke liye koi server nahi hai.
aboutP2: Compression Canvas API aur WebAssembly codecs (MozJPEG, WebP, AVIF, OxiPNG) se aapke device par hi hoti hai. Isliye ye offline bhi kaam karta hai, aur isme na account chahiye na upload.
aboutP3: Ye ek static site hai. Hosting lagbhag free jaisa hai, kyunki bhaari kaam server par nahi, visitor ke browser par hota hai.
privacyP1: Hum aapki images collect, upload, store ya share nahi karte. Drop ki hui har file aapke device par hi rehti hai aur wahin process hoti hai.
privacyP2: Is build me koi analytics, ad tracker ya account nahi hai. Aapki settings (theme aur language) sirf aapke browser ke localStorage me save hoti hain.
privacyP3: Agar aap is project ko khud deploy karke baad me analytics ya contact form add karte ho, to publish karne se pehle ye page update karo — tracking ke saath 'no tracking' ka daava mat karo.
termsP1: ImgCompressor as-is, free use ke liye diya gaya hai, un images ko compress karne ke liye jinke use ka haq aapke paas hai.
termsP2: Aap apni files ke liye zimmedar ho. Is tool se illegal content process mat karo, aur un images ka metadata mat hatayo jinke owner aap nahi ho ya permission nahi hai.
termsP3: Processing local hai, isliye delete ki hui file hum recover nahi kar sakte, aur lossy compression se quality loss ke liye hum liable nahi hain. Zaroori originals sambhal kar rakho.
faqQ1: Kya meri images kahin upload hoti hain?
faqA1: Nahi. Compression 100% aapke browser me hoti hai. Page load hone ke baad internet band karke test kar sakte ho — compression phir bhi chalegi.
faqA2: WebP size aur compatibility ka best balance hai. AVIF aur chhota hai par encode slow hai. JPEG photos ke liye, PNG graphics aur transparency ke liye best hai.
faqQ3: List me koi format kyun nahi dikh raha?
faqA3: Sirf wahi formats dikhaye jate hain jo aapka current browser asli me encode kar sakta hai. Ye runtime me chhote canvas test se check hota hai, isliye silent fallback nahi hota.
faqA4: Haan, pehli baar load hone ke baad PWA offline kaam kar sakta hai. Kisi format ka WASM codec pehli baar us format ke use par download hota hai.
notFoundSub: Ye page exist nahi karta. Compressor par wapas jao.
footerNote: No uploads. No backend. Aapki images is device se bahar nahi jati.
pasteHint: Tip: Ctrl+V / Cmd+V se image paste bhi kar sakte ho
how1Text: Drag, browse ya paste karo. Kuch upload nahi hota — files aapke device par hi rehti hain.
how2Text: Balance ke liye WebP, sabse chhote size ke liye AVIF, compatibility ke liye JPEG/PNG.
how3Title: 3. Ek-ek karke ya ZIP me download karo
how3Text: Pehle compare karo, zaroorat ho to crop karo, phir alag-alag ya sab ek saath download karo.
demoCaption: Slider drag karo — asli sample, WebP quality 55 par compress kiya hua.
feat1Text: Images aapke device se bahar kabhi nahi jati. Leak, sell ya hack hone ke liye koi server hi nahi hai.
feat2Text: Na upload, na queue, na processing server. Aapka browser milliseconds me kaam kar deta hai.
feat3Text: Dher saari images queue karo, har ek ka status dekho, aur sab ek ZIP me le jao.
feat4Text: Format, quality, max size aur metadata stripping — aur jaldi chahiye to presets bhi hain.
feat5Text: Original aur compressed ke beech slide karo, pehle crop karo, phir wahi download karo jo sahi lage.
feat6Text: Ek baar load hone ke baad app installable hai aur bina internet ke chalta hai.
